notes.title: Version 0.80b
notes.content:
All changes from the beta version of the game have been transferred to the main branch of the game.

Version 0.80
Update:

Fixed saving problem after join/exiting challenge mode

Fixed saving in the potions tab

Some QOL improvements for potions and magnets tabs

Updated visual style of Sloar Lens

Fixed checking the availability of updating the chest

Fixed a bug when the wand in the electricity tab gave magnets

Fixed a bag that could cause players to have negative resources on unlocking the magnets tab


Version 0.79Update:
Long road (in medals) to ease the path forward

Guild reward (in medals) to make guild quests easier

Time scrolling fixed

Optimization of crown flight effects

Fixed second pot saving in potions

You can choose how many potions to use with a single click

Unlocked souls in potions now save upon a guild reset

Heroes level up faster

Clicking on empty space with opened settings closes them

Fixed spider's abiliy (damage dealt ny it was counted as click damage)

Fixed some typos


Version 0.78Update:
Optimization of calculation algorithms

Fix for saving sediment and souls splitting in the potion system

Display of the time before the auto-save in the settings menu

Minor visual changes


Special thanks to:ItsMonster

Version 0.77Update:
Added training arena (heroes tab)

Potion system added (new tab)

Star system added (obtained by resetting the switch in the electricity tab)

Fixed hero cup rewarding algorithm

Fixed offline dust gathering from spheres

Fixed the text of the hint for buying generators (in the electricity tab)

Fixed rare bug with preloading textures

Fixed prism offline damage calculation

Minor visual changes


Special thanks to: Niki, tremir, hyco aka Gnuffe and 76561198300029324

notes.title: Version 0.71 - VM build
notes.content:
We disabled the YYC build of the game due to a large number of complaints about instability. Now we have left only one build - VM build, and we will focus on optimizing and improving the stability of this particular build.
 Magnet fixes.
 Update for Chinese fonts.

notes.title: Version 0.66 - Electricity
notes.content:
Update:

 Added an electricity tab.
 Changed the cost of cards after opening red cards.
 Bonus deli chest now does not reset, and is given once every 20 hours.
 New features in medals, such as disabling negative effects to heroes.
 Fixed the guild balance.
 Changed the mechanics of shield chests, now they depend on the maximum shields obtained.
 Edits to interfaces and minor bugs.

notes.title: Minor technical update
notes.content: Technical update -- uploaded a build of the game via the so-called yyc compiler. This may increase performance a bit.

notes.title: Version 0.66 - Backfixes, chest upgrades
notes.content:
Version 0.66 - Backfixes, chest upgrades


 Added the ability to upgrade the chests! Upgraded chests will start opening silver cards immediately.
 You can now keep artifact progress in the forge when restarting the guild (for crystals). We will soon add artifact saving at every 3rd level.
 Tweaked the balance of some guilds.
 Bugfixes!

notes.title: Bug fixes from the latest version
notes.content:
Fixed an engine compilation bug, so most game crashes should be fixed.
We apologize for any inconvenience that may have occurred
